_comment: v1.11.5 - the fourth and last De Bello Gallico batch: Book VII (9), which finishes the Gallic War at its allocated 40. Eight are whole chapters; VII.77 takes sections 12-16 only, the proposal and the indictment of Rome, and its citation says so. Source defects: VII.52.2 prints `Euit` for `Exposuit`, and VII.3.1 and VII.28.2 print `Vbi` with the ancient capital V for U (as does Perseus) - all three emended, the last two for the same reason `Vxores` became `Uxores` in v1.11.4.
